meta.title: InnerOutliner - Outline. Focus. Done.
meta.description: InnerOutliner is a local-first task outliner that turns scattered ideas into executable plans. Private by design - no cloud, no account required.
meta.keywords: InnerOutliner, task outliner, local-first, todo app, task manager, productivity, offline
meta.ogDesc: A local-first task outliner. Your data stays on your device. Always.

hero.lead: Turn scattered thoughts into a clean, executable task structure. Nested outlines, subtasks, reminders - everything stays on your device.

privacy.summary: How InnerOutliner handles information and protects your privacy.

sections.heading: Local data by default
paragraphs: Your tasks, outlines, reminders, and settings are stored locally on your device.
InnerOutliner does not require an account or upload your task data to our servers during normal use.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: InnerOutliner does not collect personal information from within the application.
If you contact us for support, we use the information you provide only to respond to your request.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
paragraphs: Because your data remains on your device, you are responsible for keeping backups and securing access to your device.

terms.summary: The terms that apply when you use InnerOutliner.

sections.heading: Using the app
paragraphs: You agree to use InnerOutliner in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
You may use the app for personal or business task planning, provided that use does not violate these terms.

sections.heading: Availability
paragraphs: InnerOutliner is provided as-is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability or compatibility with every environment.
We may update, change, or discontinue features as the app evolves.

sections.heading: Your data
paragraphs: You are responsible for your content and for maintaining backups, since your data is stored locally on your device.

security.summary: How InnerOutliner reduces risk with a local-first design.

sections.heading: Local-first architecture
paragraphs: InnerOutliner is designed to keep your task data on your device, minimizing remote attack surface.
No always-on cloud synchronization is required for normal operation.

sections.heading: Device protection
paragraphs: Protect your device with a strong sign-in method and keep its operating system up to date.
Install app updates when available to receive the latest improvements and security fixes.

sections.heading: Reporting concerns
paragraphs: If you believe you have found a security issue, contact us through the support channel listed on the main site.
